description: Check the address, reverse name and forward address triple that receivers actually evaluate. Reports an address with no reverse name, which many receivers refuse before the message body is sent; a reverse name that resolves to a different address, so forward confirmation fails, which is worse than having none because it looks configured; a provider-generated name; and a HELO that does not match the reverse name. Pay 140000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

expected_domain.description: The domain the reverse names should sit inside. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

hosts.description: The triples to check. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

address.description: The sending address, IPv4 or IPv6.

forward_addresses.description: What the reverse name resolves to forwards. Without it forward confirmation is reported as not checked, and that is the check receivers apply.

helo.description: What the host announces itself as. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

ptr.description: What the address resolves to in reverse. Omitting it means there is none. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

name: reverse_dns_consistency_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every host had a reverse name, every one was forward confirmed, and every check the caller asked for was performed.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Reverse DNS Consistency Audit
